title: AC1027 MTEXT LTYPE XDATA target transport

scope.source: Runtime-generated ASCII and binary DXF records; no repository fixture file was added.
scope.cross_product: One selected MTEXT target in each of model-space ENTITIES and named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS, across all four source/output encoding pairs.
scope.linetype: Source-bound simple LTYPE with the existing MLINE_LTYPE_XDATA APPID provider.

xdata.payload: One ordered group-1005 soft-pointer to source handle 0xA900.

references.target: model-space MTEXT or named-block MTEXT, selected per profile

targets.fields: Same selected MTEXT field values as the model-space profile.

proof.source: Physical source records bind the group-1005 reference to the exact MTEXT record and owner in each selected section. Typed import checks exact DRW_MText identity and the listed insertion point, dimensions, text, style, alignment, rotation, line spacing and extrusion fields.
proof.output: For each ASCII/binary source/output pair, physical output checks the target type, section, remapped handle/reference, owner and selected MTEXT fields. Fresh adapter readback checks the exact DRW_MText type, owner and selected values.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the target independently refuses export and preserves the existing destination, then succeeds on same-adapter retry for all eight placement/encoding profiles. Separate model-space and named-block late-handle mutation cases refuse without replacing the destination and succeed after the source identity is restored.

focused_ctest.result: PASS (1/1, 22.94 seconds); selector asserts the whole-test counts above

validation.asan: NOT_RUN; this slice adds a generated target profile and classifier mapping.

limits: This qualifies one selected MTEXT field profile as a code-1005 target in model-space ENTITIES and named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS under AC1027, for the authored ASCII/binary source/output combinations. Other MTEXT fields, formatting, columns, linked contexts, versions, block roles and target pairings remain open.

This is selected identity, field transport, output/readback and transaction evidence. It does not establish complete MTEXT schema, font/rendering semantics, recursive document closure, native consumer behavior, independent CAD semantics or any general DWG/DXF support claim.
